original_obligation.quoted_target: For each epsilon>0, the displayed boosted matrix has unique timelike kernel u_chi; this packet proves only the preceding exact kernel-span bridge.

scope.conclusion: Under epsilon,b2,b3>0, a vector is killed by boostedB iff it is a real scalar multiple of uChi.

theorem_signature: theorem boostedB_mulVec_eq_zero_iff (epsilon chi b2 b3 : Real) (he : 0 < epsilon) (h2 : 0 < b2) (h3 : 0 < b3) (v : FourVector) : (boostedB epsilon chi b2 b3).mulVec v = 0 ↔ ∃ t : Real, v = t • uChi chi
